display_name: Tri-SIG-TIME 拒绝样本的跨接收机分支复核与物理确认
scope: Phase1 ManySig Main split F0, original full reference-response PAMF, three views and fixed local shuffle [0,5,3,6,2,1,4,7]. Two methods, each with seeds 2026092701, 2026092702, 2026092703. F0 target is previously exposed development data.
initialization: Exact source-only Tri-SIG-TIME E20 for each seed followed by own E10+E20 to fixed E50 (11100 total updates). Same source L/U, days, RXs and existing head. No target data or U truth in training.
controls: Ordinary PL on same F0 test inputs
Clean-only branch certificate with matched probe compute
evaluation: Fixed E50; clean plus six practical scenes. DURA-LU primary, DURA-L and raw secondary. Main combines disjoint cross_rx and cross_both (168000 physical packets per scene); cross_date is diagnostic. Independent scoring only after all six prediction matrices freeze. Report per scene, seed, TX/RX/day, paired corrections and regressions. Exclude leo_weak.
success: Positive paired three-seed means versus Tri-SIG-TIME on clean and practical-six mean, and positive paired mean versus PL in every scene. Report every individual seed loss; stronger all-condition attainment requires every PL scene-by-seed cell positive and independent protocol confirmation.
expected_artifacts: Own E30/E50 and actual rejected-U coverage counters
Independent scores and paired same-packet report
